Every police document. Numbered, verifiable and counted.

Dr. Kayode John FemiFounder & CEO, 7Ai Ltd
Force Headquarters, Abuja · November 2026
The problem

Two gaps the Force lives with every day

01

Documents get lost or altered

Statements, complaints and case files are handwritten on paper. They can be misplaced, damaged, swapped or changed, and there is no simple way to prove which version is the original.

Cases weaken. Public trust suffers.
02

The Force cannot see its own data

Crime figures are compiled by hand from paper registers. They arrive late, incomplete and hard to compare across commands, so planning and deployment happen without a clear national picture.

Decisions made without the numbers.
NPF e‑Docs · Proposal by 7Ai Ltd
The solution

One number and one QR code for every document, issued at the moment it is created

Genuine?

A scan confirms it was issued by the Force.

When and where?

Date, time, division and GPS location.

By whom?

The recording officer's identity and number.

Changed since?

Any alteration is detected and shown.

NPF e‑Docs · Proposal by 7Ai Ltd
How it works

Five steps, from the counter to the courtroom

1

Capture

Officers type on a tablet, scan a handwritten statement or dictate. Maker, officer and witness sign on screen.

2

Stamp

The unique number and QR code are issued instantly, with date, time, location and officer ID.

3

Secure

The document is sealed with a digital fingerprint. Any later change is recorded and visible.

4

Sync

Works fully offline. Documents upload automatically when network returns.

5

Verify & report

Courts and prosecutors verify by scan. Force HQ sees live statistics by command, division and offence.

Documents covered: suspect, witness and complainant statements · complaints and diary entries · bail bonds · police reports and extracts · charge sheets

Capture and seal

Numbered in seconds, even with no network

  • Type, scan or dictate in English, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo or Pidgin.
  • Signatures bound to the text. Change a word and they no longer match.
  • ACJA 2015 safeguards checked before sealing.
  • Print with QR for the paper file.

Verification and integrity

Anyone can check it. Nobody can change it silently.

QR verification. The public sees only whether a document is genuine. Courts, prosecutors and defence counsel sign in to read it, and every view is logged.

Chain of custody. Every action is recorded with who, when and why. The original wording is always preserved and can be proven in court.

Security and data protection

The Force owns the data. It never leaves Nigeria.

7Ai operates the system. All records belong to the Nigeria Police Force.

  • Hosted in Nigeria, in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
  • Encrypted on every device and in transit.
  • Access by role. An officer, a prosecutor and a court registrar each see only what they need.
  • Every view and action logged, including by system administrators.
  • Lost tablet? Data on it is encrypted and can be wiped remotely.

National rollout

Phase 2 · Months 7 to 15
